title: devs survival modpack
description: this modpack adds multiple performance and qol mods
body:
This modpack focuses on smoother gameplay and a better overall experience without changing the core feel of Minecraft.

Featuring a curated selection of performance mods, it reduces lag, improves FPS, and optimizes the game for both low-end and high-end systems. Alongside that, a variety of quality-of-life tweaks streamline everyday tasks, refine the interface, and remove small frustrations, all while staying close to vanilla gameplay.

Whether you’re building mega-bases, exploring, or playing with friends, this pack keeps your world running fast, stable, and user-friendly—no unnecessary bloat, just pure performance and comfort.
